performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is a spend-surge dilution effect — efficiency was never stable.

findings.text: ROAS dropped 62.03% WoW as spend surged 50.99% — 28-day ROAS sits at 4.43x on $1,500 spend, but daily revenue is erratic: 5 of 28 days show zero purchases.

3-day purchases signal (Sep 6–8): 1+2+5=8 purchases, vs prior 3 days (Sep 3–5): 4+1+1=6 — slight upward tick, but revenue per purchase Sep 8 ($450.98/5) is lower than Sep 7 ($191.02/2), signaling smaller basket sizes.
OVERDUE: 4 milestones past Aug 31 deadline — Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test Closed + UTM Live, SEO Phase 1 Guardrails — all unresolved as of today Sep 9.
OVERDUE: Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 was due Aug 14 — 26 days past deadline; no completion record. Real-footage pipeline stalled, directly limiting ad creative refresh velocity.
GBP actions dropped to exactly 0 for 9 consecutive days (Sep 1–8) after averaging 28/day in Aug — channel_dark signal; 37 calls and 78 directions in 28-day window now at risk of being cut off.

suggestions.text: Hold Meta spend at current ~$63/day; watch 3-day ROAS trend through Sep 12 before any scale move.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend surged 50.99% WoW and ROAS fell 62.03% — the 3-day purchase trend (8 purchases Sep 6–8 vs 6 prior 3 days) is marginally improving but basket size is shrinking. Hold daily budget at ~$63 and do not scale the 'BWS - Sales - Muslims' campaign ($846.02 of 28-day spend) until ROAS stabilises for 3 consecutive days. Re-check on Sep 12; if 3-day ROAS is above 4.0x and purchases hold ≥2/day, bring a scale recommendation.

suggestions.text: Escalate GBP dark flag immediately — 9 days at 0 actions after 28/day August average requires account-access check.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions collapsed to zero on Sep 1 and have remained at zero for 9 consecutive days, versus a 28/day August average (489 total actions in the 28-day window including 37 calls and 78 directions). This is likely a listing suppression, ownership verification lapse, or dashboard disconnect — not a demand drop. Assign Nacer to verify GBP listing status and access today. Success check: non-zero GBP actions restored and confirmed in the data feed by Sep 12.

suggestions.text: Unblock Funnel Test + UTM tracking overdue since Aug 31 — zero UTM data is masking true ROAS and preventing attribution reconciliation.
suggestions.monday_update: The Funnel Test Closed + UTM Live milestone was due Aug 31 and remains incomplete. Without UTM parity, the 4.43x ROAS figure cannot be reconciled between Meta and Shopify — the known inconsistency in Shopify purchase event firing means revenue attribution is unreliable. Assign Khurram (existing owner) to close the conversion test (code ihbp8pmtn8) and confirm UTM parameters are firing on all Meta traffic by Sep 12. Success check: Windsor shows UTM-matched sessions on ≥80% of Meta click-throughs.
